newsitem.title: UK: GrandMet down on talk of Big Mac discounts.
newsitem.headline: GrandMet down on talk of Big Mac discounts.

text.p: Shares in Grand Metropolitan Plc dropped on Wednesday as a report in the Wall Street Journal said McDonald's -- which rivals GrandMet's Burger King unit -- was launching its biggest discounting programme to date.
The WSJ report said McDonald's planned to drop the price of a Big Mac to 55 cents from $1.90, when bought with fries and a drink.
GrandMet shares were down 11-1/2p at 465-1/2 by 1145 GMT in volume of 4.3 million shares. McDonald's shares were quoted down $3/8 at $47 in European trading.
Dealers said there was talk that Burger King may respond with price cuts of its own. No-one at GrandMet was immediately available for comment.
